reasoning: On the season so far the Nets are the stronger team; with home court the Bucks start about 1 points better, in a game of about 229 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing barely change it.
The mental side leans about 1 point towards the Bucks (look-ahead, streak).
Bottom line: the Bucks win 57 times in 100, by about 3; most games like this end between 202 and 250 total points.
